ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map

No. 20-F in the area bound by:

South Halsted Street; the Chicago, Rock Island, and Pacific Railroad; a line 43.5 feet
west of and parallel to South Givins Court; a line 316 northwest of and parallel to the
alley next northwest of and parallel to South Vincennes Avenue; a line 106.9 feet west of
and parallel to South Givins Court; the alley next north of and parallel to South
Vincennes Avenue; the alley next west of and parallel to South Gilbert Court, South
Vincennes Avenue; a line 271.5 northeast of the intersection of South Halsted Street and
South Vincennes Avenue as measured along the north right-of-way line of South
Vincennes Avenue and perpendicular thereto; the alley next north of and parallel to
South Vincennes Avenue; and South Halsted Street,

to those of a B3-3, Community Shopping District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Yoel Mo

Ronnia L. Mosley |
Alderman, 21** Ward

Common Address:

8576-8626 S. Vincennes Avenue
8529-8549 S. Halsted Street
845 S. Givins Court
